title: Recurse Tier Configuration (v1.0)
description: Per FR-015. Customer-deployment configuration; YAML on disk, JSON Schema is the validation contract. Integrity hash verified out-of-band per FR-033 (accidental-corruption detection only; cryptographic signing deferred to Phase 2).

tier.description: Phase-1 ships managed_saas + standalone_gateway; vpc_runner is contract-preview; appliance deferred to Phase 2

topology.description: Phase-1 supports single_node ONLY. The reserved value 'federated' is NOT a permitted Phase-1 value (rejected at config-load time per Constitution Reconciliation §1).

tenant_id.description: ULID; fixed deployment-config value (BEAM-per-customer per FR-019)

enabled.description: false in standalone_gateway tier; true in managed_saas / vpc_runner / appliance
Always true in Phase 1; the Gateway is present in every shape

netns.description: true for Governance shapes (managed_saas / vpc_runner / appliance); false for standalone_gateway

observed_identity.description: true for standalone_gateway; optional for appliance

impl.description: fully-qualified Elixir module name implementing PrincipalProvider behaviour

identity_broker.description: FR-053 — only relevant when tier == standalone_gateway

byo_jwt_issuer.description: if true, customer brings their own JWT issuer; broker disabled even if enabled flag is true

providers.description: Provider Interface bindings — fully-qualified Elixir module names + per-impl config

version_pin.description: FR-039 — exact Cedar version this deployment was canonicalized against; CI stability fixture asserts hash invariance against this pin

rate_limits.description: FR-023 — per-plane mechanics; numeric defaults set at /speckit-plan time

features.description: Feature flags map for finer-grained activation. Documented per-feature in Deliverable F.

impl.description: fully-qualified Elixir module name implementing the corresponding behaviour

config.description: impl-specific configuration; passed to the impl's init/1
